title: Apartment upper floors and finished roofs
caption: Open galleries, framed upper windows and a finished L-shaped roof now match across the courtyard and neighbouring island views. Every retained capture attempt is included below.

sections.title: First baseline attempt
sections.caption: Eleven retained desktop frames from f1eef49a2. The capture stopped at the dorm opening dialogue before phone views; this was a harness timing failure.

sections.title: Complete baseline
sections.caption: Thirty frames from f1eef49a2: staged player approaches, elevated court details and the playable upper corridor and roof. Court detail views use a diagnostic camera; the approaches use the desktop follow or phone overview camera.

sections.title: Baseline building comparisons
sections.caption: Twenty-four diagnostic architecture views from f1eef49a2, in morning and evening. These are elevated fixed cameras; the phone camera is widened to fit the building, rather than the normal player view.

sections.title: First apartment milestone
sections.caption: Thirty frames after 10b7344e8: staged player approaches, court details and existing corridor/roof access. Later review found the blank return-end face in neighbouring views; the repair is shown below.

sections.title: First model attempt, before repair
sections.caption: Twenty-four elevated diagnostic views after 10b7344e8. Independent review rejected twelve for blank wing faces. These failed views remain here alongside the repaired attempt.

sections.title: Repaired upper floors and neighbouring views
sections.caption: Twenty-four diagnostic views of the framed end windows, floor lines and corrected sento roof. Captured from the staged source committed unchanged as c9d81782a; the generated build stamp still showed 10b. Independent apartment review: 8/10. Phone camera widened for the model comparison.

sections.title: Repaired buildings from the playable approach
sections.caption: Four fresh c9d81782a approaches from the east coast, morning and evening, desktop follow and phone overview. Independent apartment review: 8/10. The preceding deferred after-2 job produced no PNG frames; its log remains in the evidence.

sections.title: Final roof finish, diagnostic views
sections.caption: Eight native views from committed 28f7541cd. Structural roof finishes use neutral grey so physical surface checks classify them as roof rather than foliage. Geometry is unchanged. Independent review: 8/10 throughout. These are elevated diagnostic cameras, widened on phone. The generated build stamp still showed c9; morning phone frames retain a faint objective-card animation edge, so the evening frames are the final highlights.

sections.title: Desktop corridor and roof interaction attempt
sections.caption: Five retained screenshots from real room/corridor/stair/roof checks. The subsequent courtyard-return harness call timed out because it called a marker callback outside the game interaction lifecycle; the corrected run follows. These controlled interaction checks are separate from the approach captures.

sections.title: Corrected door, cutaway and courtyard return
sections.caption: Six native screenshots from the real game interaction lifecycle on desktop and phone: door 203, room cutaway, corridor and courtyard return pass. This short run checks the return route; the upper-stair and roof checks are shown separately above. Earlier harness reference/timing attempts produced no PNG frames and remain logged in the evidence.
